The '''campaign on Kooriva''' was a battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] which took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kooriva/Legends|Kooriva]]. [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] participated in the battle.<ref name="commandercody" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was mentioned in [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody's]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry on [[StarWars.com]]. The entry mistakenly spelled the planet [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]], which is in fact the name of the [[Species/Legends|species]] that adopted [[Kooriva/Legends|Kooriva]] as its [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="commandercody" />
